elements.title: PYTHON CODE
elements.details: Python code snippet showing how to calculate 95% confidence intervals for intercept and slope using scipy.stats.t.interval with sample data arrays intercepts and slopes. The code imports scipy.stats as st and numpy as np, calculates intervals a_min, a_max for intercepts and b_min, b_max for slopes, then prints the intervals.
elements.summary: This code demonstrates how to compute 95% confidence intervals for regression intercept and slope parameters using Python's scipy.stats package.
